title: Naturality of integral line-bundle extension classes on pro-etale towers
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an arbitrary morphism of schemes. Use the pro-etale inverse image of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] componentwise on abelian towers [def-sp-tower-class-systems], denoted $F:D(\mathrm{Ab}(Y))\to D(\mathrm{Ab}(X))$. Let $z:F\mathbf Z_{\bullet,Y}\to\mathbf Z_{\bullet,X}$ be adjoint to the constant-section map, and $a:F G_Y[1]\to G_X[1]$ the shifted derived comparison induced by pullback of full units, where $G_T=\operatorname{const}(\mathbf G_{m,T})$. All single and shift comparisons are the canonical exact-functor ones. For any invertible module $L$ on $Y$ [def-sc-invertible-module], let $\lambda_L:\mathbf Z_{\bullet,Y}\to G_Y[1]$ be lineBundleClass of [def-sp-tower-class-reduction], defined by the canonical Picard torsor class, etale-to-pro-etale inverse image, the full-units comparison, and the constant-tower functor. Then $F(\lambda_L)a=z\lambda_{f^*L}$, with composition written from left to right. No invertibility of the full-units comparison and no flatness of $f$ is assumed.

proof.text: Construct the explicit normalized square of the line bundle and its module pullback. Its ordinary class square follows from the existing arbitrary-scheme Picard cohomology naturality theorem and the two ordinary site-comparison endpoint identities. The proved normalized constant-tower transport theorem gives the required equality with exactly integerDerivedPull, unitsDerivedPull and lineBundleClass as defined originally.

theorem tower_integralClass_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L : Y.Modules) [Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible L] :
    (abPull f).mapDerivedCategory.map (lineBundleClass Y (Scheme.Pic.ofIsInvertible L)) ≫
        unitsDerivedPull f =
      integerDerivedPull f ≫
        lineBundleClass X (Scheme.Pic.ofIsInvertible ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L))
